summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its daily share repurchases from April 20–24, 2026, as part of a €1 billion buyback programme announced on February 17, 2026. The company bought a total of 1,291,910 ordinary shares, with prices ranging from $96.00 to $98.81 on US trading venues and £72.45 to £72.95 on the London Stock Exchange. The first tranche of the programme completed on April 24, acquiring 5,873,426 shares for ~€500 million. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. This is a capital return event returning cash to shareholders.
